major_events.description: Ye Fan, Sheng Huangzi, and Jizi lead an alliance of sacred lands to attack the ancestral ground of the assassin dynasties 'Di Yu' and 'Ren Shi Jian', using the Green Copper Tripod and Goddess Furnace to breach the ancient arrays.
Ye Fan and Jizi confront the fleeing killer saints in the干涸混沌时空 (Dry Chaotic Realm) to prevent future retaliations.
The Tai Gu Ren Mo (Human Demon) Dongfang Ye's predecessor wakes up in the cosmos, roasting and eating Golden Crow saints who attempted to claim his chains.
Ye Fan and the Human Demon join forces to purge the Dragon Nest (万龙巢), forcing the ancient royal races to retreat from Beidou.
The spaceship fleet of the Eternal Star Field invades Beidou's star sector to capture the Life Tree, leading to a clash between ancient cultivators and high-tech war vessels.
Ye Fan and Long Ma arrive at the First Pass of the Human Trial Road, facing corruption and arrogance from local guardians.
The Dao of the Source (道之源) rejects Ye Fan due to his Holy Body bloodline and unconformed path; Ye Fan uses it to wash his feet in defiance.
Ye Fan successfully overcomes the Saint Tribulation (圣人劫) in deep space and achieves sainthood.
Ye Fan enters the Yan Clan territory and executes corrupt enforcement officers, establishing his reputation as a defender of justice.
Ye Fan and his party face the invasion of Saint Spirits (圣灵) at the Great Moon Slope burial grounds, where Holy Spirit armies attempt to break the sealed gates.
The Old Madman returns in a middle-aged form, using the Six Paths of Reincarnation Punch to shatter the right hand of the supreme Saint Spirit Ao Mang.
Ye Fan leads an army of 100,000 Heavenly Soldiers (天兵) to secure the Supreme Head (至尊头颅) on the star road.
Ye Fan steps on the blood-written challenge of Hun Zhan, confirming their fated match at the 50th City.
Ye Fan fights the Heaven Overlord Body Hun Zhan in the starry sky, culminating in a brutal match of Golden Blood against Purple Blood.
Pang Bo breaks out of the Demon Emperor's virtual tomb after the Demon Emperor's Ruler (妖皇尺) is claimed by cosmic forces.
Ye Fan triggers a massive Saint King-level tribulation, fighting shadows of the Nine Holy Bodies, the Undead Emperor, and Di Zun.

long_form_mechanisms.details: The hidden infrastructure of Ren Shi Jian and Di Yu involving pocket realms, sacrificial arrays, and generational brainwashing of infant killers.
The perilous cultivation path of concurrently mastering the Taiyin and Taiyang scriptures, leading to extreme power but causing sanity to cycle between daytime divinity and nighttime madness.
A technological civilization system utilizing high-energy spaceships, mechanical exoskeletons, and refined genetic evolution fluids (进化液) to synthesize cultivation breakthroughs.

long_form_mechanisms.mechanism: Human Starry Trial Road Guard System
long_form_mechanisms.details: A network of star cities guarded by receiving messengers (接引使) and law protectors (护道者), acting as both a filter for young supremes and an institutional filter for factions.

long_form_mechanisms.mechanism: The Dao of the Source (道之源) Approval System
long_form_mechanisms.details: A natural cosmic entity representing cosmic endorsement. Fuses with a cultivator to dramatically boost potential, but rejects those (like the Holy Body) whose path defies the natural order.
The intense tribulation process featuring elemental punishment, stellar lightning fields, and phantom copies of ancient emperors that a half-saint must survive in deep space to achieve sainthood.

long_form_mechanisms.mechanism: Holy Body vs. Overlord Body Rivalry
long_form_mechanisms.details: A generational bloodline conflict between Golden Blood (Holy Body) and Purple Blood (Overlord Body), featuring mutually exclusive physiological traits and signature moves (Six Paths punch vs. Overlord punch).
The metaphysical process of utilizing ancient Buddhist/Daoist scriptures (like the Du Jie Sutra) to pacify or dissolve the residual malicious thoughts of deceased ancient supreme beings.

continuity_observations.details: The fragments of the Green Copper Tripod retrieved in earlier volumes remain Ye Fan's primary defensive tool against ancient saint-level killing arrays.
The text directly refers to the Old Madman's self-sacrificial battle against a ship of ancient saints in the Ziwei Star Field, detailing the wreckage and explaining how he survived.

continuity_observations.observation: Pang Bo's 青帝 (Emperor Qing) legacy
continuity_observations.details: Pang Bo's development continues to build upon his collection of Emperor Qing's personal notes and genetic fluids, bridging back to his demonic lineage.

continuity_observations.observation: Human Demon's release from Wan Long Nest
continuity_observations.details: The narrative notes that the Human Demon was originally retrieved by Ye Fan from the Ten Thousand Dragons Nest, maintaining continuity with the earlier search of Beidou's frozen depths.
Ye Fan utilizes the mysterious scripture obtained from the Nine Dragon Coffin to stabilize and claim the broken pieces of the Demon Emperor's Ruler.
The star roads of different races (human, demon, god) are described as distinct paths that eventually merge into a single main road, consistent with the cosmic layout.
The manifestation of the Sun Emperor's evil thought and his subsequent actions on Beidou reinforce the legacy of the ancient Human Emperors established in earlier volumes.

continuity_observations.observation: Di Zun and the Mythological Heaven
continuity_observations.details: Mentions of Di Zun and the Undead Emperor during Ye Fan's tribulation reinforce the history of cosmic transitions established in earlier volumes.

style_observations.details: In the Eternal Star Field chapters, the author frequently blends modern technological jargon (mother-ship, energy beam, genetic evolution) with traditional Daoist cultivation terminology.
The narrative frequently repeats phrases highlighting the absolute rarity and supreme standing of the Holy Body and Overlord Body to build dramatic tension for their duel.
Combat descriptions make heavy use of astronomical scale, claiming saints can 'shatter stars' or 'shout down moons' to amplify the scale of battle.
The base of Ren Shi Jian is described as a peaceful, pastoral farm village with croaking frogs, contrasted immediately with the bloody gate of killers inside.
Breakthrough stages and tribulations are designated with dramatic, spiritually-heavy terminology (e.g., 千劫百难, 斩敌明道) to highlight the psychological struggle.
The author uses Long Ma's dialogue (such as claiming to be '马大爷' and cursing the guardians) to inject crude, light-hearted humor into the high-stakes journey.

originality_risks.details: The Dao of the Source rejecting Ye Fan because 'the heavens do not recognize the Holy Body' sets up a standard underdog trope where the protagonist is fated to fight against cosmic destiny.
The protector Qi Tian showing strong bias towards the Overlord Body and using 'peace and letting go' to suppress Ye Fan is a classic xianxia cliché of corrupt institutional authority.
The confrontation between golden and purple bloodlines follows a formulaic path where the fated rival exists primarily as a benchmark to highlight the protagonist's superior physique.
The Human Demon roasting powerful gold crow saints for food relies on the repetitive trope of using powerful beast-like antagonists as culinary comedy.
